key_insight: Dynamic routing adds a second test-time adaptation axis for LLMs beyond chain-of-thought, enabling fast, training-free gains from a few demonstrations.
engineering_relevance: For AI/engineering workflows, routing can improve accuracy and efficiency on new tasks without gradient updates, especially under distribution shift.
method: Score candidate routing programs by how likely they make the demo labels.
Use the model’s own confidence to arbitrate between routing strategies.
Combine routing with chain-of-thought when both are available, since they solve different queries.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on 49 MMLU tasks across seven models, with notable gains on out-of-distribution ARC-AGI where routing doubled a 7B model’s accuracy.
watch_item: Confidence-based routing can miss latent potential and unsuccessful routes may push activations out of the distribution expected by later layers.
paper_title: Dynamic Routing as a New Dimension for Test-time Versatility of LLMs
